purpose: Versioning and release tagging contract for CYNIC public projection.

tagging.tag_target: commit SHA on forgejo/main after release gate

release_notes.generation: automated from conventional commits since last tag

public_notes.review: optional human review before public relay

distribution_manifest.purpose: machine-readable release metadata for downstream consumers

public_projection.condition: release gate passed + versioning contract satisfied

rules.rule: CYNIC release versions follow semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) with optional hybrid date suffix for traceability.
notes: MAJOR: breaking changes to public API or contracts

rules.rule: Git tag is the source of truth for a release version. No release exists without a tag.
notes: Tag is created on forgejo/main after release gate passes

rules.rule: Release notes are generated from conventional commits since the last tag.
notes: Public notes may be reviewed before relay but generation is automated

rules.rule: Build release artifacts include SHA-256 checksums for integrity verification.
A distribution.yaml manifest accompanies each release with name, version, description, and environment requirements.
Public projection (GitHub) never includes secrets, tokens, private keys, or credentials.
notes: Secrets remain in /etc/cynic/secrets/ with mode 0600, root:cynic
Reference via credential_ref in infra/repo-remotes.json only
